author: Jesse Garcia
title: Kyle Bradish goes 7.2 but takes tough-luck L in 3-2 loss
desc: Kyle Bradish allowed three earned runs on five hits and one walk while striking out five over 7.2 innings in Sunday's loss to the Reds
impact: After the loss, he now has a 3.75 ERA and 1.40 WHIP with a 5-9 record across 18 starts. Bradish was solid Sunday against the Reds, he just did not get any run support from the Orioles' offense. He is currently slated to take on the Royals in his next outing.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Cade Smith logs clean frame as Guardians fall 7-6
desc: Cade Smith threw 16 pitches over one scoreless inning in Sunday's 7-6 loss to the White Sox.
impact: Smith hasn't been provided with a save chance for over a week, but was out there in the ninth inning to try to keep it a one-run game. Ticketed for his first All-Star game next week, Smith now has a 2.90 ERA and 1.14 WHIP with 26 saves and three blown saves across 38 appearances.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Joe Ryan silences Yankees with seven scoreless frames
desc: Ryan allowed no earned runs on three hits and one walk while striking out nine over seven innings in Sunday's 6-1 win over the Yankees.
impact: Ryan dominated the New York lineup, notching an impressive 17 swinging strikes in the win. After Sunday's win, Ryan now has a 3.36 ERA and 1.04 WHIP with a 6-5 record and 122 strikeouts across 19 starts. His final start before the All-Star break will come against the Angels on Sunday.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Kahlil Watson swipes two bags in one-run loss
desc: Kahlil Watson went 1-for-5 in a 7-6 loss to the White Sox on Sunday with two stolen bases and one strikeout.
impact: Watson kept his fantasy value alive with his legs, even if the bat stayed mostly silent. After Sunday's loss, Watson is slashing .246/.271/.351 with one home run, nine RBI, and six steals across 17 games. The rookie's speed on the basepaths has been a welcome addition to Cleveland's lineup.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Gabriel Arias Clubs Homer, Drives In Three in One-Run Loss
desc: Gabriel Arias went 2-for-5 with a home run, one run scored, three RBI, and three strikeouts in a 7-6 loss to the White Sox on Sunday.
impact: Arias did what he could, launching a huge three-run blast to tie the game at 6-6 in the fifth inning. After Sunday's loss, Arias is batting .221 with four home runs, nine RBI, eight runs scored, and one stolen base across 26 games. He's hitting .250 with two homers and four RBI over his past seven games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Chase DeLauter Goes Deep in One-Run Loss
desc: Chase DeLauter went 2-for-5 in a 7-6 loss to the White Sox on Sunday with a home run, two runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: DeLauter's two-run homer in the first inning tied the game at 2-2. Through 74 games, he's batting .272 with eight home runs, 41 RBI, 29 runs scored, three steals, a .330 wOBA, and a .294 BABIP. He's hitting .323 with one homer and five RBI over his past seven games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Steven Kwan swipes a bag, but Cleveland comes up short
desc: Steven Kwan went 1-for-2 in a 7-6 loss to the White Sox on Sunday with a walk and one stolen base.
impact: Kwan's quiet season continues as he has not swung the bat or stolen bases up to his normal standards. Through 83 games, Kwan is batting .221 with one home run, 14 RBI, 35 runs scored, and four stolen bases, with a .280 wOBA and .246 BABIP.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Tanner Bibee torched early as Guardians fall 7-6
desc: Tanner Bibee allowed six earned runs on six hits and one walk while striking out one over four innings in Sunday's 7-6 loss to the White Sox.
impact: Bibee got singed in a short outing, and Cleveland paid for it in a one-run loss. After Sunday's start, Bibee now has a 4.06 ERA and 1.14 WHIP with a 2-9 record through 19 starts. His next start will be Saturday against the Marlins.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Javier Assad gives up two hits in start Sunday
desc: Javier Assad allowed no runs on two hits and two walks while striking out two across 4.2 innings in Sunday's 6-4 win over the St. Louis Cardinals.
impact: After allowing four earned runs in relief on June 30 against the Padres, Assad bounced back Sunday with a strong outing, throwing 80 pitches without allowing a run. He has been highly effective when used in the rotation, posting a 3.65 ERA and 1.05 WHIP across 37 innings. His next outing remains unclear, as he could either start again or operate out of the bullpen.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Pete Crow-Armstrong swipes two bags Sunday
desc: Pete Crow-Armstrong went 2-for-4 with a run scored and two stolen bases in Sunday's 6-4 win over the St. Louis Cardinals.
impact: Crow-Armstrong has reached base safely in seven straight games and has been on a tear during that stretch, slashing .429/.613/.762 with two home runs and five stolen bases. He has been one of the top outfielders in the league this season, leading all outfielders with 23 steals while ranking fourth with 19 homers.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ben Williamson swipes bag Sunday
desc: Ben Williamson went 1-for-4 with a stolen base in Sunday's 2-0 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: Williamson drew his second start in the last five games with the Tampa Bay Rays on Sunday and managed to record a hit. He has struggled in his first season with Tampa Bay, slashing .238/.312/.324 across 64 games.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Chandler Simpson steals base Sunday
desc: Chandler Simpson went 1-for-4 with a stolen base in Sunday's 2-0 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: Simpson returned to the lineup on Sunday after missing a couple of games due to jammed fingers suffered July 2 against the Kansas City Royals. He didn't miss a beat, extending his hitting streak to eight games while adding his third stolen base during that stretch. On the season, he is hitting .277 with 21 steals.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Mason Englert strikes out nine in loss Sunday
desc: Mason Englert allowed two runs on five hits and one walk while striking out nine across 5.2 innings in Sunday's 2-0 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: Englert delivered one of his strongest outings of the season despite taking the loss, striking out a season-high nine while allowing just two earned runs over  5.2 innings. Over his last three appearances as a bulk reliever or starter, he has allowed just three runs across 14.2 innings. It's unclear when his next outing will be, as he could be deployed either as a starter again or in a bulk relief capacity.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Otto Lopez hits homer in second straight contest
desc: Otto Lopez went 3-for-4 with a home run, a double, a walk two runs scored and three RBI in Sunday's 8-7 win over the Athletics.
impact: Lopez crushed a 420-foot solo homer off Mason Barnett in the sixth inning to give the Marlins their seventh run of the game. He has now recorded four straight multi-hit performances and has gone deep in back-to-back contests. Lopez has been one of the league's hottest hitters to begin July, slashing .522/.520/1.000 across 23 at-bats.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Leo Jimenez goes yard Sunday
desc: Leo Jimenez went 1-for-4 with a home run, one walk, one run scored and two RBI in Sunday's 8-7 win over the Athletics.
impact: Jimenez drew the start at designated hitter on Sunday with left-hander Gage Jump on the mound and took advantage of the matchup, launching a 405-foot, two-run homer in the third inning. Despite the productive performance, Jimenez is best left on the waiver wire due to his limited playing time and .571 OPS on the year.
